definitions.explanation: Extremely intense, severe, or violent; exceeding normal limits in a way that inspires awe or fear.

examples.japanese: すさまじい{勢|いきお}いだった。
すさまじい{競争|きょうそう}が{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げられた。
{爆発|ばくはつ}のすさまじさに{言葉|ことば}を{失|うしな}った。
examples.english: I was speechless at the ferocity of the explosion.

notes:
すさまじい describes something so extreme or intense that it inspires awe, fear, or disbelief. It carries a stronger and more literary tone than すごい.

FORMS:
- すさまじく (adverbial): すさまじく{速|はや}い (terrifyingly fast)
- すさまじさ (noun form): {爆発|ばくはつ}のすさまじさ (the ferocity of the explosion)

KANJI:
Can be written as {凄|すさ}まじい, though hiragana is more common in modern usage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- すさまじい{勢|いきお}い: tremendous force/momentum
- すさまじい{競争|きょうそう}: fierce competition
- すさまじい{音|おと}: tremendous noise
- すさまじい{破壊力|はかいりょく}: devastating destructive power

SIMILAR WORDS:
- すごい: amazing, terrible (more casual, wider range of use)
- {激|はげ}しい: intense, violent (often for weather, emotions, movement)
- {猛烈|もうれつ}: fierce, furious (more formal, often in writing)
